ID counts and proportions by Length_range and Condition

Source: R/counting.R
count_ids_condition_bylengthrange.Rd

Computes peptide/sequence/protein counts for each Condition × Length_range combination (plus an "All peptides" total row per Condition), pivots to long format, and derives the proportion, percentage, and cumulative proportion/count of each Length_range class relative to its condition's total — the table consumed by plot_prop_length_condition().

Usage

count_ids_condition_bylengthrange(input, group_var = "Condition")

Arguments

input

A pep_all-shaped data frame with Condition (or the column named by group_var), Length_range, Peptide, Sequence, Accession columns.

group_var

Name of the grouping column. Default "Condition"; pass "Sample" to compute per-sample proportions.

Value

A long-format data frame of counts/proportions/percentages per group_var × Length_range × Level (Peptides.Modified/Peptides/ Proteins), with Length_range factor-ordered for stacked-bar plotting. The grouping column retains the name supplied in group_var.

Details

Defines its own internal count_ids(input, ..., total = FALSE) helper (grouping on arbitrary ... columns, with an optional synthetic "Total" row) — note this shadows the package's simpler count_ids() for the duration of this function only; the two serve different call patterns and were kept distinct rather than unified, to stay faithful to the original "imported from functions_thunder" implementation.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
count_ids_condition_bylengthrange(pep_all)
count_ids_condition_bylengthrange(pep_all, group_var = "Sample")
} # }
